notes: CREATIVE_BATCH_8.md CB8-W. IMPLEMENTED 2026-10-17 (cb8_flow.flow_fetch), still a DRAFT until promoted. Needs seals/cb8_flow_rules.json COMMITTED (generated by 'run_cb8.py rules --which flow' after review; the B half of the design's seals/cb8_rules.json is a separate file), the q0161 smoke result with criterion_a_data_api_paging true (creative_batch8/smoke.json) and creative_batch8/exclusion_keys.csv.gz + exclusion_report.json (q0164). No outcome fetched or stored; raw wallets only in memory (HMAC first 32 hex, strict key, pinned fingerprint recorded in the manifest, other fingerprint -> exit 2). Output cap 0.15 GB, sticky disk_budget end state (exit 4). More than 2% unverified exclusion ids -> disjointness_unverified (W1 not testable, counted).
